parsed.explanation: Python does not allow you to join [concatenate] text strings and numbers directly using the plus sign. I used the str() function to convert the number 95 into a string so that it can be combined with the other text.
steps: Look at the error message to see which data types are causing the conflict.
Identify which variable is a number and which is a string.
